status: source-verified; food-calorie composition only; NOT a nine-group self-sufficiency dataset

source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
source.publication: World Food and Agriculture – Statistical Yearbook 2025
source.geography: Published Europe regional aggregate; UN M49-based classification. Russian Federation is its whole national statistical area, not European Russia. EU is not the aggregation boundary.
source.coverage_note: The yearbook uses sums/weighted means and publishes aggregates subject to a sufficiency threshold. Published Europe is not proof of an observation for every microstate/territory. Country and reporting-area coverage can differ across domains.

width_formula: published group kcal / sum of the nine published group kcal
interpretation: Food available for human consumption; not observed individual dietary intake. Food waste at household level is not deducted. The published Europe row already aggregates the region; do not average national per-capita values unweighted.

groups.label_ja: 乳製品・卵（バター除く）

self_sufficiency_null_reason: Same-year matched production/import/export and appropriate aggregation not acquired. Do not pair with 2021 rates.

country_names: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
country_coverage_audit.scope_note: Russian Federation national total included; Cyprus and Türkiye excluded by M49 Europe. Five microstates lack independent FBS series. The published regional row is used directly; no new population weighting has been invented.
